description: This Java class defines configuration properties for various downstream service clients used by the checkout service in the application. It utilizes Spring Boot annotations to bind properties prefixed with 'shopizer.clients' to fields representing different service endpoints such as cart, order, pricing, tax, promotions, and inventory. Each service has associated URL and timeout configurations.

classes.name: ShopizerClientsProperties
classes.description: Configuration properties class defining clients for various services used in checkout process, including validation and property binding.

classes.name: ShopizerClientsProperties.ServiceClientProperties
classes.description: Nested class encapsulating individual service client configuration such as base URL and timeout setting.
